item.title: Fukushima Waraji Matsuri: The Giant Straw Sandal Festival — Guide
item.description: The Fukushima Waraji Matsuri centres on one of Japan’s more eye-catching festival traditions — an enormous straw sandal (waraji), roughly 12 metres long and weighing around two tonnes, carried through the streets of Fukushima City by hundreds of participants each August. The giant sandal is dedicated to Haguro Shrine as a prayer for healthy legs and feet, echoing an old practice of offering oversized footwear to ward off illness, and is accompanied by energetic dance troupes and drumming through the city’s main avenues.
